controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: USGS Cassini/Voyager mosaic, about 154 m per source pixel, downsampled to the shared 8192 × 4096 layout. Photographed shadows and variable resolution remain; globe Shadows adds approximate lighting. Gray grid marks explicit source no-data. Mapped onto a simplified Cassini SPC shape; independent image control can leave local registration differences.
controls.summary: Detail varies across images from two missions. Photographed shadows remain; the gray grid marks missing observations.
controls.title: Global image mosaic

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: Published 2014 enhanced-color composite, photometrically corrected by Paul Schenk. Colors extend beyond human vision into ultraviolet and infrared. Source resolution varies; seams and residual photographed shading remain. Mapped onto a simplified Cassini SPC shape; independent image control can leave local registration differences.
controls.summary: Infrared, green and ultraviolet bands reveal colors beyond human vision. The 2014 composite retains shading and seams.
controls.title: Enhanced-color composite

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows height above the PDS 561.4 km reference sphere. Brightness shows fixed northwest relief lighting at true height scale; Shadows adds shared approximate globe lighting. Cassini SPC model released in 2025, about 1.58 km grid spacing. The globe uses a simplified version of the released Q128 shape; grid and geometry resolutions differ. Model detail and accuracy vary.
controls.title: SPC terrain model

controls.label: Relative albedo
controls.description: Relative brightness solved together with the Cassini SPC shape model, normalized around 1. This secondary model product is less validated than topography. It is neither visible color nor calibrated reflectance. Colors show 0.5–1.5; values above 1.5 saturate. Gray grid preserves source gaps.
controls.title: SPC relative brightness model

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Neutral grid over a simplified source shape, without photographic texture or height exaggeration. Source model detail and accuracy vary. Cassini SPC Q128 model released in 2025. The 2,000-face view retains broad shape; small terrain details are omitted.
controls.title: SPC shape model

controls.label: Infrared
controls.description: Cassini VIMS false color: red 2.00 µm, green 1.57 µm, blue 1.06 µm. The archive corrects illumination to incidence 30° and emergence 0°; fixed display ranges are shared with Rhea. One-degree source cells remain visible. Gray grid marks missing spectra. Archive registration is uncertain at about the source-pixel scale; no subdegree positional accuracy is implied.
controls.summary: Photometrically corrected infrared spectra, shown as false color.
controls.title: Cassini VIMS infrared mosaic

controls.label: Ice absorption
controls.description: Strength of the 2.02 µm water-ice absorption relative to a linear 1.82–2.20 µm continuum. Derived from Cassini VIMS; this is not ice percentage, grain size or crystallinity. Colors saturate below 0.30 and above 0.75. One-degree source cells and missing or invalid-continuum cells are retained. The archive has unresolved registration differences at source-pixel scale.
controls.summary: Water-ice absorption strength, derived from the original spectra.
controls.title: Continuum-relative water-ice absorption; not ice abundance
